findings.namedBuyers: Laura Maurice, Vice President, Partnerships & Client Services, is the strongest commercial introduction: the organizer explicitly names her for exhibitor and sponsor opportunities. Ilana Weitzman, Vice President, Strategic Initiatives, Clean Transportation, is relevant to programme and speaker requirements; her official biography says she curates Expo programming. Neither is verified as accommodation contracting authority. Published central route: expo@electricautonomy.com; request referral to the actual lodging/operations decision-maker.
findings.futureEdition: Official homepage and About page explicitly announce May 5–6, 2027 in Toronto. These are activity dates, not page publication dates. The edition falls within the requested horizon. No official 2028 edition announcement was located. Some ticket links and accommodation text still reference 2026; use the explicit 2027 date banner, not those legacy components.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is a city-waterfront supplemental-lodging prospect for this Exhibition Place business event, not a resort or principal Expo venue. A 157-room hotel cannot exclusively house the published 2,000-attendee scale. Potential roles are a negotiated subset of delegate/exhibitor/speaker rooms, VIP lodging or small side meetings, conditional on actual non-local demand and organizer approval. The supplied 15–109 peak-room range is a sales-sizing envelope, not published event demand. MTCC walkability does not establish walking convenience to Enercare. Confirm transport and restaurant/lounge/catering operation before pitching receptions.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue: Hall A, Enercare Centre, Exhibition Place, 100 Princes’ Blvd #1, Toronto, Ontario M6K 3C3, Canada. This is Toronto proper, within Exhibition Place, not the MTCC and not a hotel. Public venue announcement is verified; private venue contract terms are not. Combo-pass copy also identifies Hotel X for the related kWh Summit, a separate programme rather than the Expo venue.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified editions: May 17–18, 2023; May 1–2, 2024; May 14–15, 2025; April 8–9, 2026 — all at Enercare Centre, Toronto. The 2026 organizer announcement calls it the fourth year. Evidence supports repeated Toronto/Enercare hosting, not destination rotation. Do not infer fixed May dates: 2026 was in April.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging sourcing is unconfirmed. The official travel page lists only Hotel X, 111 Princes’ Blvd, Toronto, with this historical offer: “Attendees have access to a special group rate of $385 per night (plus applicable taxes) until March 6, 2026 or the room block sells out.” This is evidence of a published 2026 block, not a 2027 commitment or availability. The related kWh Summit page says a $385 CAD rate was “secured as part of Electric Autonomy’s EV & Charging Expo package” until March 11, 2026; retain the different historical cutoffs rather than reconcile them into a new offer. No 2027 room block, housing bureau, open hotel RFP, hotel procurement deadline or exclusive housing contract was verified. Route lodging questions to the producer; no evidence establishes a third-party housing buyer.
findings.organizationStructure: Electric Autonomy is the Expo producer and describes itself as a media and events company, not an association. Enercare Centre is the venue; Hotel X is the historical accommodation provider and related Summit venue. Historical 2023/2024 registration pages used andlogistix infrastructure, but this does not establish a 2027 PCO or hotel-buying mandate. Faulhaber identifies itself as the official PR agency for the 2025 edition only; that is not housing authority.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hotel X has a documented historical block and the official travel page describes it as “a few steps from Hall A,” giving it an on-campus convenience advantage. Combo-pass text also places the related Summit at Hotel X. No verified sell-out, overflow request, displaced demand, exclusivity or 2027 committed inventory was found. The third-party TradeShowIntel page names Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre, Fairmont Royal York, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Toronto Downtown, Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Toronto Downtown, and Comfort Inn & Conference Centre Toronto Airport as generic hotel options; none is verified as an organizer block or preferred-hotel commitment.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a short introduction to Laura Maurice via expo@electricautonomy.com, asking who manages Expo lodging and whether a 2027 supplemental Harbourfront room agreement is permissible alongside Hotel X. Request existing hotel commitments/exclusivity, non-local attendee and exhibitor pickup, arrival/departure pattern, peak rooms, staff/speaker requirements, allocation mechanism, rate/loading terms and decision deadline. Offer a right-sized, availability-dependent room proposal only after those answers; include Ilana for speaker/programme needs. Verify transport and hotel food-and-beverage operation internally before offering side events. If 2027 is closed, request the next lodging review date, not a presumed 2028 RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, venue access is established but commercial lodging access is not. No evidence supports marking hotel sourcing open or all lodging committed elsewhere. Ask whether Hotel X is renewed, exclusive, capacity-limited or supplemented; independently booked attendee rooms remain possible in principle, not evidenced group business. The qualified-buyer pass concerns buyers of EVs/charging, not hotel procurement.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated Toronto/Enercare editions support nurturing a supplemental downtown lodging relationship, initially for 2027 if the organizer confirms access, otherwise for a later cycle. Historical Hotel X involvement suggests supplementing rather than assuming displacement. No announced 2028 dates or open future accommodation tender was verified; future capture is a strategy, not confirmed demand.
